Pakistan’s first YouTube-verified wildlife education channel.
I am Abdul Rahman, also known as “Venom Boy,” from Mandi Yazman, Bahawalpur, near the Cholistan Desert. My wildlife journey started in 2013, I am a professional Survivalist, Self-defence Instructor, Reptile Handler, and Wildlife Documentarian, dedicated to protecting wildlife and promoting animal welfare. Trained by Discovery Channel Instructor Chad Keel.
I have rescued and safely released over 16,000 animals, including snakes, reptiles, and birds. I travel across Pakistan, sometimes barefoot or by bicycle, to explore wildlife, document their behavior, and raise awareness.Wild Rush Mission is to break myths about wildlife passed down through generations, promotes conservation, and encourages safe coexistence between humans and animals.

Subscribe my channel and Join me on this journey, be part of our mission, and help protect wildlife, our ecosystem, and the environment.
